plan.purpose: SK hynix only (000660): same pre-specified 48 TeddyNote-style analog conditions and next-20-session cumulative price return as Samsung experiment
plan.data: Frozen Naver daily prices 2019-01-02 through 2026-10-07; no interpolation or synthetic data
plan.validation_library: For each validation year, use only historical episodes whose 20-day outcomes finished before the first validation signal of that year. Freeze this library throughout the year.
plan.validation_queries: Signal dates in validation year, with full 20-day outcome also inside that year; common minimum 100-day observed history for all configurations
plan.test_library: All eligible episodes with outcome before first 2026 signal; frozen, excludes every 2026 outcome
plan.normalization: Min/max of each input window only, then unit L2 norm for cosine similarity; skip constant windows
plan.episode_overlap: Greedily select by descending similarity; selected historical input-plus-outcome episodes cannot overlap (endpoint separation >= lookback+20)
plan.fallback: If fewer than 3 independent episodes selected, predict the same common historical mean return as the mean baseline. Up probability also falls back to common historical up-rate.
plan.direction_probability: Laplace-smoothed neighbor up frequency (up_count+1)/(neighbor_count+2), only if sufficient neighbors
plan.selection: Lowest mean annual validation MAE over 2022-2025, all four years equal weight; ties resolved by deterministic configuration id. Freeze selection before test scoring. Test ranking cannot change selection.
plan.diagnostic_reference: One 12-day input/0.98 cosine/mean configuration with overlapping matches allowed, on historical-only episodes. This is illustrative and excluded from selection. Raw reference daily-mean return and future-inclusive search are corrected.
metrics: matched-only error versus baseline on identical dates
plan.dependence: Daily 20-day targets overlap. Show first-date anchored nonoverlapping results and a paired moving-block bootstrap of mean-baseline MAE minus selected MAE, block length 20, 2000 repeats, seed 42. Treat uncertainty as exploratory, not proof.
plan.test_status: The Samsung test year has been inspected, but SK hynix outcomes are not used for parameter selection. Conditions fixed from the Samsung experiment before fetching SK hynix data. This follow-up shares the chosen method and test era and is not a fully independent confirmatory study.
plan.latest_prediction: Fixed selected configuration on latest completed snapshot close. Mark unverified future and explicitly identify fallback if no reliable analogs.
plan.costs: Forecast accuracy experiment, not an executable trading strategy; no transaction-profit claim
limitations: Naver price adjustment unspecified and dividend cash flows excluded
model selection uncertainty not fully captured by bootstrap
historical similarity is not a success probability

reference.description: 12-day cosine >0.98, overlapping matches allowed, mean next-20 cumulative return; future-data leak corrected; excluded from selection

bootstrap.metric: common mean MAE minus selected MAE, percentage points

crosscheck.note: Independent-provider agreement is a cross-check, not an exchange-grade certification. Naver remains frozen input; no substitutions.

source.name: SK hynix
source.adjustment: unspecified by API; no independent adjustment, dividend cash flows excluded
source.data_policy: No interpolation; invalid, duplicate, nonpositive or inconsistent OHLC fails

provider_sensitivity.purpose: Provider sensitivity only; original Naver-selected condition is fixed, no retuning
provider_sensitivity.provider: Yahoo chart raw Close, not adjusted close
provider_sensitivity.calendar_caveat: Yahoo lacks three pre-2026 Naver dates. Each provider uses its own observed 20-session horizon; historical windows may differ. No filling or replacement.

case_examples.description: Post-hoc illustration among historical pairs actually retrieved by the validation-selected configuration; not a selection rule known at forecast time.
case_examples.selection_rule: Same-direction pair with highest future-path correlation; opposite-direction pair with largest future-path MAE. Both use observed future only to explain results, never for model selection.
